turns.content: For four identical spin-1/2 fermions in a one-dimensional infinite well, state the one-particle energies in units of E and the spin-orbital occupancy rule.
Fill the levels for the many-body ground state and calculate its total energy.
Find the lowest excited occupation obtained by the smallest allowed promotion and calculate its energy.
Find the next-lowest distinct allowed occupation and calculate its energy.
State the ordered ground, first-excited, and second-excited energies.
Check that no lower configuration is allowed under the particle statistics and occupancy rule established in the first two turns.
Report the three energies and occupation patterns.
